# `mise daemons status`

- **Usage:** `mise daemons status [ARGS]…`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/daemons.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/daemons.rs)

[experimental] Show the status of project daemons

Prints pitchfork's status for each selected daemon. With no names, covers every daemon the project has registered.

## Arguments
- **`[ARGS]…`** — Daemon names (short, such as `api`, or qualified, such as `shop/api`), `--group NAME`, and flags passed to pitchfork

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Show the status of api

```
mise daemons status api
```
